# shopify-support-chat

> A Brevo Conversations chat bubble for the admin side of a Shopify app: merchants message the app developer from inside the embedded app, and each conversation is tagged with the shop, the merchant and the app. Zero runtime dependencies, ESM, MIT. Install a release tag tarball, never a branch. Admin pages only, never a storefront. Visitor identity is unverified by design. The visitor is one flat object of scalar properties (email, firstName, lastName, notes, SHOP, MERCHANT, APP, IDENTITY). lastName is the app and notes is "<shop> · UNVERIFIED…": standard Brevo fields shown in every account; the custom keys show only if the Brevo account has contact attributes with those names, as Brevo's updateIntegrationData requires.

## Docs

- [Agent setup guide](https://github.com/01ecommerce/shopify-support-chat/blob/main/docs/agent-setup.md): deterministic steps for an AI coding agent integrating the package into a Shopify app, with exact code per stack and a verify checklist
- [README](https://github.com/01ecommerce/shopify-support-chat/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, options, CSP, privacy
